incident.summary: The lower-driver agent first checked the wrong repo-root build path, then ran the forced normal build against concurrently changed upper-layer sources. That build overwrote the retained CubeIDE normal output with BC850B... before its E1997F... bytes were copied to a protected path.
incident.followup_search: No remaining byte-exact E1997F... HEX was found under repository build outputs or .cache/validation references.
incident.disposition: Recorded without concealment; fail closed and require an existing exact artifact or a separately authorized recovery contract.

implementation.diagnostic: software 4-wire SPI; one boot; three fixed groups; one 0x2F byte then one 0x2D eleven-byte response per group
implementation.gpio_restore: PC1 output-low, SCL-low, CS-high after every bounded response

resume_requirement: Supply an existing byte-exact E1997F... normal HEX artifact. Do not reconstruct it by rolling back the shared dirty worktree and do not contact hardware while it is missing.
